mostWorthwhile.text: Making the steam cloud was most worthwhile: it clearly distinguished invisible water vapour from the visible droplets in a cloud.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the rain-filled hollows was clear but somewhat predictable after the preceding collection step.

surprise.text: I expected water to collect directly on the crust, but it first produced a cloud because the crust was still hot.

arbitrary.text: Combining tides with the ocean to create a coast felt somewhat abstract: the result explained the tidal shore, but the action did not itself make clear where the coast came from.

continue.text: Yes. The concise explanations of clouds and tides made the sequence informative, and the tidal shore suggests an interesting transition to coastal life.
